items.a: On the days of slaughter (Eid day and Tashreeq days), with documentation sent immediately after.

items.q: How can I confirm my sacrifice was performed?
items.a: We send photos and video from the field along with your unique sacrifice number.

items.q: What is the ruling on appointing a proxy?
items.a: Appointing a proxy for the sacrifice is permissible by the consensus of jurists.
Distributed to poor and displaced families in the country of slaughter, with priority to Gaza.

items.q: Can I dedicate the intention to a specific person?
items.a: Yes, write the name in the intention field and it will be mentioned at slaughter.

items.q: What is the difference between the three tracks?
items.a: Track 1: slaughter in Africa and feed Gaza. Track 2: slaughter, canning and shipping to Gaza. Track 3: live sacrifices in 7 countries.
